lete-prompt presets. Zero dependencies.
# dsh-inject-head
Inject a fixed block of text at the **very top** of every DeepSeek Harness system prompt — including
presets that normally discard outside contributions.
Zero dependencies. One file to edit. Takes effect on the next turn, no restart.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Why this needs two mechanisms
DSH assembles a prompt by sorting sections ascending on `(order, name)` and joining the non-empty on
es with blank lines. A section at order `-5000` therefore lands above `harness:identity` (`-1000`) a
nd the deployment persona (`0`):
| Section | Order |

| `operator:head` ← **this plugin** | `-5000` |
| `harness:identity` | `-1000` |
| `deployment:perso

na-prefix` | `0` |
| tools / policies | `1000 … 9900` |
| `deployment:persona-suffix` | `10200` |
But a preset declared `complete: true` (for example `minimal`) runs `sections: [ownPersona]` at the
end of assembly and throws every other section away. No section can reach it — that is host behaviou
r, not a limitation of this plugin.
So the plugin registers **two** things from the same text source:
1. the global section `operator:head` at order `-5000`, with `interpolate: false` so braces and `{{…

}}` in your own words can never break an assembly;
2. the prompt variable `inject_head`.
Section-based presets get the text for free. For a `complete: true` preset, add one line to that pre
set's persona prefix:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The same file still drives the text. Nothing else about the preset changes.
## Install
The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so it installs as a normal bundle.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Then point the plugin manager at the cloned directory — `install_bundle` with its absolute path — or
add it to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json` by hand:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Link the package into the profile's `node_modules`, then restart the harness once. Editing the text
afterwards never needs a restart.
## Configure
One text source, four levels, highest priority first:
| Priority | Source | Notes |

| 1 | `DSH_INJECT_HEAD_TEXT` | inline; trimmed |
| 2 | `DSH_INJECT_HEAD_FILE` | path to a UTF-8 file

; trimmed |
| 3 | `$DSH_HOME/inject-head.md` | default path (`~/.dsh/inject-head.md`) |
| 4 | `DEFAU
LT_TEXT` in `index.mjs` | `''` — inject nothing |
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- **edit** the file → next assembly picks it up (cached on `mtime`)
- **empty** the file → injection

silently stops
- **delete** the file → nothing is injected
Use the environment variables when you want the text to travel with the shell rather than with the h
ome directory — useful for per-project overrides.
## Verify
Ask the harness to dump the composed prompt, or check the first line of any session:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The plugin row appears as `inject-head` with `name` pointing at `index.mjs`. To check the assembled
prompt instead, ask your agent *"what is the first line of your system prompt?"* — it should be your
ask your agent *"what is the first line of your system prompt?"* — it should be your text verbatim.
Run the plugin's own tests:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Limits
- **`complete: true` presets need the one-line persona edit.** The plugin cannot inject a section in

to them; only the variable route works.
- **Don't edit a preset persona that another plugin asserts
on.** Some plugins validate a preset's persona by exact string equality and silently disable themsel
ves when it changes. Adding `{{inject_head}}` to such a preset will trip that check — use a differen

t preset, or leave that one uncovered.
- **The text enters session history.** It is part of the syst

em prompt, so it shows up in exported or shared sessions. Never put secrets in it.
- **It costs toke
ns every turn.** A short line is negligible; a paragraph is not.
## 中文说明
在每份系统提示词的最上方注入一段固定文本。

- 唯一真源是 `~/.dsh/inject-head.md`，改完下一轮即生效，不用重启
- 清空文件即关闭注入，删除文件则什么都不注入
- 也可用 `DSH_INJECT_HEAD_TEXT`（直
接给文本）或 `DSH_INJECT_HEAD_FILE`（指定文件）覆盖
覆盖范围：普通 preset（standard / ptc / cordis 这类按 section 组装的）自动生效；声明了 `complete: true` 的 preset（如 `minimal
`）在组装末尾会丢弃所有其它 section，需要你在它的 persona 前缀里加一行 `{{inject_head}}`，文本仍由同一个文件驱动。
已知边界：若某个 preset 的 persona 被其它插件按精确字符串校验，改它会让那个插件静默失效 —— 这种情况请换一个 preset，或让它保持不覆盖。注入内容会进入会话历史，导出或分享会话
reset 的 persona 被其它插件按精确字符串校验，改它会让那个插件静默失效 —— 这种情况请换一个 preset，或让它保持不覆盖。注入内容会进入会话历史，导出或分享会话时可见，不要放密钥。
